title: post-state-change hook payload (stdin)
description: Fired on every real state or activity change of a run (and when the report's status or reported_at changes, cause report), in order, at least once (deduplicate on event_id). Delivered by exec while its wrapper runs; for a run with no live wrapper, synchronously by the command that changes it (start, stop, forget, wait, resume, reconcile) or by the next delivering command; status and list never run hooks. A per-session delivery lease prevents concurrent double delivery. Exactly one final: true per run. Fires every turn; filter with the states selector. Cannot veto. state, activity, needs_input_reason, previous_state, previous_activity, cause, final, live, labels, event_id and event_ts describe the event. Every other field describes the run when the payload is delivered (ts), so a late or repeated delivery can show a later report, pending, phase, message or session_end_reason than the change it reports, and a redelivery of the same event_id can carry different values for these fields.

repo.description: Repo id host/<full project path> (no . or .. segments).

ts.description: When this payload was delivered, taken for each entry just before it runs (delivery is at least once; see event_ts for post-state-change). Every field that does not describe the event describes the run at this time.

event_id.description: The state event's id (events.id). Delivery is at least once: deduplicate on (object_id, event_id).

event_ts.description: When the state change happened (ts is the delivery time).

pending.description: true while the run is pending (created by start, not yet adopted), at delivery time (ts), not at the event.

phase.description: launch for a pending run and launch-phase ends; session once claude was spawned. At delivery time (ts), not at the event.

reads_third_party.description: When true, notification templates exclude report.summary and report.reason by default.

decision_ids.description: Decision ids from --decision-id and from pre-launch hook stdout.

final.description: true for the run's last change: outcome, end_reason and exit_code are then non-null and state is final. Exactly one per run, including runs that ended in the launch phase (state not-started).

report.description: The run's report at delivery time (ts), not at the event: a late or repeated delivery can show a later report than the change it reports.

exit_code.description: The run's outcome code when final; else null.

session_started_at.description: When the run's first SessionStart hook was recorded; null if none was seen (launch-phase ends, pending runs, claude gone before SessionStart).

session_end_reason.description: The reason of Claude Code's last SessionEnd hook for this run, verbatim; null if none was seen. At delivery time (ts).

message.description: Launch failure message (the error, its detail, then the hint when there is one) or pre-launch hook stderr (control characters stripped, capped at 2 KiB); never agent text. At delivery time (ts).
